summary.content:
Today's selection covers 88 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 52 on Artificial Intelligence and 7 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Elon Musk said control of OpenAI should go to his children, Sam Altman tells jury
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Signal adds security warnings for social engineering, phishing attacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 66 articles published in the last 24 hours
